name: Claude Code session
description: Opens a long-lived conversation with Claude Code in a project as one Job. The job runs the optional first 'prompt', then waits in INPUT_REQUIRED with the reply as its output; every message sent to the job ({"content": "..."} — or {"prompt": ...}) is the next turn, and {"end": true} finishes it (completing with a summary). Between turns the process stays warm (subject to the pool's idle timeout and live cap) and is respawned transparently — the conversation lives in Claude Code's own session on disk, so it survives reaps and even venue restarts. Use this from clients that hold a job handle (REST/SSE, A2A); an agent using Claude Code as a tool should call claudecode:run with 'session' instead. Same authorisation as claudecode:run.

prompt.description: First turn (optional: without it the job opens the session and waits for input)

project.description: Project name. Optional when you can use exactly one project, or when 'session' names a known session.

session.description: Resume an existing Claude Code session in this job

model.description: Model alias or full name (e.g. sonnet, opus, fable, claude-fable-5). Defaults to the project's / adapter's default, else Claude Code's own.

fallbackModel.description: Model to fall back to when the primary is overloaded or unavailable

permissionMode.description: Claude Code permission mode. Headless runs have nobody to answer prompts, so 'default' denies anything that would ask; 'acceptEdits' auto-approves file edits; 'plan' is read-only planning. 'bypassPermissions' is only allowed when the project itself is configured with it.

tools.description: Restrict the built-in tool set, e.g. ["Read", "Grep", "Glob"] for a read-only run; [] disables all tools

maxTurns.description: Maximum agentic turns for the run; when reached the job fails with error_max_turns and a resumable session id

maxBudgetUsd.description: Maximum API spend for the run in USD (informational under a subscription login)

appendSystemPrompt.description: Text appended to Claude Code's default system prompt — instructions, conventions, constraints

systemPrompt.description: Replace Claude Code's system prompt entirely (rarely wanted; prefer appendSystemPrompt)

jsonSchema.description: JSON Schema for structured output; the result then carries 'structured' (the validated object) as well as 'result' (its JSON text). Needs at least 2 turns.

agent.description: A Claude Code agent (from the project's .claude/agents) to run as

keepAlive.description: Keep the process warm after the turn for fast follow-ups (default true; the pool reaps idle processes after idleSeconds and caps live ones at maxSessions). false: the process exits after this turn; the session is still resumable.

options.description: The same per-call options as an object

output.description: While waiting for input: the latest turn's result (as claudecode:run). When ended: {project, session, turns, ended: true}.

result.description: Claude Code's final text for the turn

structured.description: Validated structured output when jsonSchema was given

session.description: Claude Code session id — pass as 'session' to continue this conversation

subtype.description: success, or an error kind (error_max_turns, error_max_budget_usd, error_during_execution)

permissionDenials.description: Tool uses Claude Code refused under the permission mode — if a task could not be finished because of these, widen allowedTools or the mode
